The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 afb7bf56f8d97111), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF pages 4-5. statement: Let S be a smooth connected projective surface over C with pg(S) = 0. Then h(S)Q is finite-dimensional in the sense of Kimura and t2(S) = 0. If, in addition, q(S) = 0, then h(S)Q ≃ 1 ⊕ L⊕b2(S) ⊕ L2 . 4 In this case, for every m, n ≥ 0, the rational Chow motives of the power Sm and the Hilbert scheme S[n] of length-n zero-dimensional subschemes are pure Tate, with S0 = S[0] = Spec C. For Y = Sm or Y = S[n], the rational cycle-class maps satisfy cli Y : CHi (Y )Q ∼ − − → H2i (Y, Q), H2i+1 (Y, Q) = 0 for every i ≥ 0.
